title: Received tool call after parse (V-1) and offering (V-2) checks
description: PROPOSED (LOOP-v0.8 §7.2; R12-1). One tool call as the host loop received it from one model response, before V-3. Names are Chirality's own semantic names; no wire field of any provider or supplier is selected. The representation it is assembled from is the model-interface basis named in model_interface_basis (for fixtures: FB-CC-1, fixture basis, not a product selection).

model_interface_basis.description: Label of the basis the call was received under, e.g. FB-CC-1.

position_in_response.description: Order of the call within its model response.

call_correlation_identity.description: The model's call identity; null when none was received.

operation_reference.description: The named catalog entry; null when none was received.

argument_text.description: The argument text exactly as received and assembled, never repaired (MC-9); null when none was received.

argument_value.description: The parsed argument object when the text parsed completely to an object; otherwise null.

oneOf.description: Passed V-1 and V-2; goes on to V-3 on its own (R12-7).
Rejected before dispatch; class 1 result for this call only.
